items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Uh… George, of course. Billy Hart for drums.

ctx.x: And so, who else was in the George Shearing group? How large was it?
Uh… George, of course. Billy Hart for drums. Fantastic drummer. [inaudible]. It feels good, he said, with [Lang?] there.
